question: Does recovery training from placed lying starts against a hidden get-up reference (RECOVERY.md) give a PyTorch-trainer policy that gets up from placed lying starts and rejoins its command, and does that policy keep tracking the 40 LAFAN1 clips, against the same recipe without recovery?

trainings.initial_weights: none: each training initialises its networks from its seed, so the two conditions of a seed start from equal weights and the two seeds from different ones

placed_starts.body_rows: evenly spaced over the start rows of configs/recovery.args
placed_starts.command_rows: evenly spaced over the rows outside the command-excluded clips of configs/recovery.args whose next command_upright_rows rows are upright and before their clip's last row
placed_starts.pairing: trial i takes the i-th body row and the command row that a permutation from the same generator gives it, drawn after the uniforms
placed_starts.uniforms: unit uniforms in [-1, 1) from one torch CPU generator, in this order: position [100, 3], rotation [100, 3], velocity [100, 6], joints [100, 29]
placed_starts.twins: the same command rows, each started at its command row alone

first_rows.trials: the first row of each of the 40 clips, in library order
first_rows.controls: the longest clip's rows minus one; each clip is read over its own rows minus one

fall_recovery.source: StableMimic (arXiv 2608.02385v1), Section IV-A: the fall rule's pelvis height of 0.50 m and tilt of 60 degrees, and the 20 s horizon. Every other value is this study's choice

quantities.R: placed starts that get up, of the 100; trials outside the fall rule at placement and trials with a numerical failure count as not got up
quantities.J: placed starts that rejoin their command, of the 100
quantities.J over R: rejoined trials over the recovered trials whose rejoin was readable; unavailable when no recovered trial's rejoin was readable
quantities.F: twins with a counted fall, of the 100
quantities.C: clips of the 40 completed from their first row under the recipe's termination
quantities.C_getup: whether each of the five hidden get-up clips is completed
quantities.E: body-position error in metres: the command's bodies moved under the body's torso by the alignment of BeyondMimic (arXiv:2508.08241v4, Supplementary Text S1, Anchor), applied to all 14 tracked bodies; the distance averaged over the bodies, over each clip's controls before its first termination and over the 40 clips
quantities.seed suffixes: C0, C1, E0 and E1 are C and E of the control trainings of seeds 0 and 1; R0 and R1 are R of the recovery trainings of seeds 0 and 1

tracking_C.or: |C0 - C1| of the control seeds at the control save compared with

tracking_E_m.or: |E0 - E1| of the control seeds at the control save compared with

still_rising.or: |R0 - R1| of the recovery seeds at 3,000 updates

classes: each seed's recovery save at 3,000 updates: near_zero (R <= near_zero), gets_up (R >= gets_up_R and R >= the larger control R at 3,000 + gets_up_lead), some otherwise

outcomes.name: run_stopped
outcomes.when: a training ends before 3,000 updates by an engine capacity overflow or by the wall time
outcomes.taken_to_mean: an engine or budget result, not a recovery result; the saves that exist are read as stated
outcomes.sends_forward: the failing update read first; then a larger engine build or restricted starts

outcomes.name: split_seeds
outcomes.when: one seed gets_up and the other near_zero
outcomes.sends_forward: more seeds of the same pair

outcomes.name: control_within
outcomes.when: at each seed the control's R at 3,000 is above near_zero and within control_within of the recovery R at 3,000
outcomes.taken_to_mean: the tracking recipe on this base already rises toward an upright command; no get-up is attributable to the hidden target
outcomes.sends_forward: the control's get-ups read before any recovery change

outcomes.name: precondition_unmet
outcomes.when: no seed gets_up, and the control completes none of the five hidden get-up clips (C_getup) at 1,500 and at 3,000 at both seeds
outcomes.taken_to_mean: this base at this length does not get up even with the get-up visible as the command; a low R cannot be attributed to hiding the get-up recording from the actor or to the reward
outcomes.sends_forward: longer absolute-base trainings read on the get-up clips; a longer pair

outcomes.name: still_rising
outcomes.when: a seed that is not gets_up has R at 3,000 minus R at 1,500 above still_rising
outcomes.sends_forward: the same trainings continued to 6,000 updates in output directories of their own

outcomes.name: no_get_up
outcomes.taken_to_mean: hidden-target training at this length does not produce a get-up from these placed starts
outcomes.sends_forward: one training with the hidden row in the actor's input, under a declaration of its own

outcomes.name: some_get_up
outcomes.when: no seed gets_up (both some, or one some and one near_zero)
outcomes.taken_to_mean: some get-up, not established as the hidden target's
outcomes.sends_forward: the per-start reading of which starts rise (scene.json and trials.jsonl), before any change

outcomes.name: gets_up_without_rejoining
outcomes.when: both seeds gets_up and J over R below rejoins_J_over_R at either seed
outcomes.taken_to_mean: getting up without rejoining; candidates are the return to the command (the horizontal command offset set at the switch, the 75-control reward blend back to the command, and a critic whose input does not say whether a control is recovering, blending or tracking) and the heading at the switch
outcomes.sends_forward: an input entry for the critic that states whether a control is recovering, blending or tracking, and the reward blend, first; not a policy of two expert networks and a mixing network

outcomes.name: gets_up_and_tracks
outcomes.when: both seeds gets_up, J over R at least rejoins_J_over_R at both, and C, E and F within their margins against the control at 3,000 at both seeds
outcomes.taken_to_mean: getting up and rejoining are reachable with the PyTorch trainer at this length, per seed
outcomes.sends_forward: a longer pair; pushes; a reading of tracking where the command itself is in a low posture

outcomes.name: tracking_cost_at_exposure
outcomes.when: both seeds gets_up, J over R at least rejoins_J_over_R at both, and at both seeds tracking outside a margin against the control at 3,000 and within every margin against the control at 1,500
outcomes.taken_to_mean: consistent with a cost of tracking exposure; the comparison also differs by twice the updates and the place on the learning-rate and target-change schedules, so it does not isolate exposure
outcomes.sends_forward: a longer pair at equal tracking exposure

outcomes.name: tracking_worse
outcomes.when: both seeds gets_up, J over R at least rejoins_J_over_R at both, and at both seeds tracking outside a margin against both control saves
outcomes.taken_to_mean: tracking is worse than both control saves; not separated from the recovery share of window rows and the shared step budget
outcomes.sends_forward: a study of a policy of two expert networks and a mixing network, with a question of its own

outcomes.name: no_call
outcomes.when: any case no row above takes
outcomes.taken_to_mean: no call; each seed's class and readings are stated
outcomes.sends_forward: more seeds of the same pair

unreadable_when: a declared save has no reading (readings.py refuses an incomplete record, a record of another scene, termination, control count, weights or checkpoint, a record whose rows are not its scene's, and another library), or E at a save is unavailable (a clip without a body-position error)
a training's config.json names another seed, other updates, checkpoint interval or hours than declared, or recovery options that do not fit its condition

the two trainings of a seed have config.json files that differ outside the recovery options, out, config, engine.path and engine.artifact (the card, source revision, image, engine identity and capacities, torch version, library inputs and every other option included)
a training ended in any other way than its 3,000 updates, a capacity overflow or the wall time
